description: This file is a main React component for a web application page involving complex UI for persona generation, upload handling, status polling, and state management within a Next.js frontend. It defines a sophisticated user interface for uploading documents, configuring persona details, viewing draft and finalized personas, and orchestrating backend API interactions.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Represents a professional experience entry within a persona, including id, role, company, date, and description.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Defines the shape of the persona data used in UI, including name, title, summary, skills, experiences, education, etc.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Represents uploaded files with id and File object.

classes.name: BuildStatus
classes.description: Type representing the status of a build process fetched from API.

classes.name: PersonaVersion
classes.description: Type representing version history info of personas.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts unknown values to string arrays, filtering non-string elements.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Safely stringifies an unknown value to JSON, with error fallback.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts message string from an unknown error object.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label string for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely navigates nested objects using a path array, returns value and found path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys present in objects for debugging orchestration payloads.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration record, prioritizing persona-shaped objects.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend JSON to UI PersonaData shape, handling key mapping and fallbacks.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component managing the persona builder UI, state, API interactions, file uploads, and rendering logic.
